pcs.pc_description: Identify and describe drone types (fixed-wing, rotary-wing, hybrid) and categories (nano, micro, small, medium, large).
Explain applications of drones across sectors (agriculture, defence, logistics, surveillance, mapping, cinematography, disaster management).
Relate application demands (payload, sensors, range, endurance, flight conditions) with changes in design and manufacturing requirements.
Identify and describe the function of major drone components (frame, motors, ESCs, flight controllers, GPS, sensors, batteries, propellers, antennas).
Interpret CAD drawings, exploded views, wiring diagrams, and technical datasheets for different drone categories.
Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM) and part lists using suitable design or ERP software.
Identify tools, jigs, and fixtures required for precision assembly and fastening of drone components.
Verify incoming components against the BOM and ensure compliance with design tolerances and quality standards.
Plan the assembly sequence as per the drone type and complexity.
Assemble the drone frame and structural components following torque, alignment, and balance specifications.
Mount motors, ESCs, and propellers in the correct configuration (X, +, or H orientation) as per the design.
Connect wiring harnesses, power distribution boards, and connectors using standard soldering and crimping techniques.
Install and secure the flight controller, sensors, and GPS units ensuring vibration isolation where required.
Integrate communication modules (RF, telemetry, GPS receivers) as per design specifications.
Assemble and connect the battery unit with power safety mechanisms (fuses, BMS, connectors).
Inspect all assemblies for loose fittings, short circuits, polarity errors, and misalignments.
Document assembly steps, component traceability, and deviations from drawings using organizational templates.
Perform a dry-run pre-power check to confirm continuity, polarity, and mechanical integrity before powering the drone.

pcs.pc_description: Conduct pre-flight functional checks and visual inspections for drones of different categories.
Verify battery health, charging cycles, and current ratings using test equipment
Test electronic subsystems (ESCs, motors, GPS modules, sensors) using multimeters, oscilloscopes, and specialized diagnostic tools.
Perform continuity checks and insulation resistance testing of wiring harnesses
Calibrate sensors (IMU, accelerometer, gyroscope, barometer, magnetometer) according to category requirements.
Calibrate GPS units and confirm lock-on performance under different environmental conditions.
Configure flight controllers with firmware updates, PID tuning, and category-specific parameters (payload balance, hovering stability, altitude limits).
Program communication protocols (RC transmitters, telemetry systems, failsafe modes) for safe flight.
Simulate drone flight dynamics (lift, drag, thrust, pitch, roll, yaw, stability) using software simulators before live testing.
Adjust thrust-to-weight ratio configurations for different payload conditions
Validate redundancy mechanisms (dual GPS, dual IMU, return-to-home systems) in programming logic.
Conduct controlled live flight tests including take-off, hovering, forward flight, and soft landing.
Assess drone performance against design requirements (flight time, payload endurance, stability).
Record real-time telemetry and flight data for performance analysis.
Compare flight test results with design specifications and identify discrepancies.
Document test results, calibration reports, and corrective actions in QA-approved formats.
Use QA/PLM software tools to update product history and compliance logs.
Approve the drone for release only after all performance and safety requirements are successfully validated.

pcs.pc_description: Diagnose technical issues in drones using systematic troubleshooting methods and diagnostic software.
Repair or replace faulty components such as motors, ESCs, sensors, GPS modules, wiring, or batteries.
Validate repair work through integrated functional and flight-readiness testing.
Upgrade drone capacity (payload, endurance, flight range) through hardware modifications or optimized programming.
Implement software and firmware upgrades to enhance drone category performance.
Review feedback on recurring failures to improve CAD designs, BOM accuracy, and manufacturing processes.
Maintain repair, upgrade, and improvement records as per organizational formats.
Stay updated with emerging drone technologies, programming techniques, and manufacturing trends.
Assist to prototyping, pilot testing, and documentation of new drone models or assembly methods.
Apply ESD safety practices, PPE, and grounding requirements across all drone processes.
Follow organizational policies on workplace discipline, ethics, and environmental sustainability.
Ensure DGCA compliance with national and international standards for drone assembly, testing, and operations.
Maintain confidentiality of organizational data and respect intellectual property rights.
